text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 45 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea near 14.8s/153.6e, moving east at 4 mph. The system should slowly weaken as it turns back towards the west during this period. This system continues to threaten shipping and boating in the Coral Sea during this period. Coastal areas of northeast Queensland will continue to see rough surf and possible beach erosion over the next couple of days.

Tropical cyclone 33p with 40 mph winds is north of the Fiji islands. This system is expected to strengthen as it tracks south and then southeast during the next 48 hours. It will become an increasing risk to shipping during the next 24-48 hours as winds increase to about 80-85 mph. It is expected to threaten the Fiji islands in a little over 36 hours. Strong winds and heavy rains may move into the islands at that time.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
